name: com.aegeanintel/data
title: BRIER Data
description: Checkable forecast calls for agents: AEIG's locked track record, with proof of each lock.

tools.name: track_record_lookup
tools.description: Look up AEIG's calls by topic, claim ID or date range. Returns each call's statement, locked probability or range, lock date, resolution rule, status, outcome and integrity proof (claims file hash, locked-fields hash, snapshot). Score figures are withheld until the public score rule allows them. Give at least one of topic, claim_id, from, to.

topic.description: A desk, claim family, brief, or words to find in the call, e.g. 'fomc' or 'brent'.

claim_id.description: A claim ID such as CLM-2026-245.

date_field.description: Which date the range applies to. Default locked_on.

status.description: Return only calls in this state: locked, open, resolved or void.

limit.description: Calls per page. The default is twenty and the most is fifty.

offset.description: How many matching calls to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: verify_call
tools.description: Prove that a call was locked before its outcome. Returns the lock and resolution dates, the first public snapshot that lists the call, the canonical locked fields with their SHA-256, and the hash chain path from the call to the published manifest and snapshot files, so the proof can be checked independently.

claim_id.description: A claim ID such as CLM-2026-245.
